page.overview:
Who is Babysitter?

Sultan is an 18-year-old who was traumatized at age 12 by babysitting an 18-month-old baby Bart. She wears a blue beret and a pink scarf.

When she arrives to the Simpson house for the second time, she recognizes Bart and screams in terror as she remembers how toddler Bart managed to start the car and drive it across the lawn in an attempt at running her over years ago. Then she runs away, leaving a confused Marge without a babysitter for the weekend.
